features.description: Every user-facing Debug Control setting is wired UI -> payload -> C++ -> state payload and round-trips through one codec.
Diagnostic panel ids, message routes and HTML assets remain present.
Universe time acceleration can be entered and exited by the real startup scene.
Galaxy, System, Detail and Hub navigation modes remain reachable and transition-tested.
Buffered presentation clock and local/remote presentation contracts remain covered.
Interaction-horizon activation, hysteresis and broad-phase contracts remain covered.
Authoritative server construction and CPU assembly geometry do not require an OpenGL context.
The real EliteGame target builds before readiness is reported.
